approximations: Names, IDs, page, pixel, audience and destination are synthetic; settings are current snapshots, not historical truth.
Reach is approximated as 80% of daily impressions; it is not measured unique reach.
Pixel event stats mirror reported actions; PageView uses link clicks as a synthetic proxy.
All breakdown dimensions use equal deterministic shares with integer remainder allocation; they are not observed performance.
Withheld creatives use synthetic placeholders; supplied assets retain packet checksums and are staged separately.
